name: managing-acute-coronary-syndromes
description: Reviews acute coronary syndrome (ACS) care for one encounter as a coordination, documentation and quality draft: STEMI, NSTEMI, unstable angina, MINOCA. Builds a timestamp ledger from EMS, ED, cath lab and transfer records and computes each reperfusion clock from its own trigger (first medical contact to device, door-to-balloon, door-in-door-out, door-to-needle, NSTE-ACS invasive timing) against the 2025 ACC/AHA/ACEP/NAEMSP/SCAI ACS guideline, kept separate from the CMS STEMI eCQM (CMS996), ACC/AHA performance measures and NCDR registry definitions. Screens ECG documentation for STEMI equivalents (posterior MI, de Winter, LBBB or paced rhythm with Sgarbossa); checks troponin against the assay's sex-specific 99th percentile; separates myocardial injury, type 1 and type 2 MI (Fourth UDMI) and primary or secondary MI (Fifth UDMI, 2026) from ICD-10-CM codes; reviews fibrinolysis contraindications, transfers, discharge medications and cardiac rehab referral. Drafts for clinician review; no patient orders.
